sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Fibronectin binding and α5β1 heterodimerization both confirmed preserved by functional assay (Fig. 1 of source paper).
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states the SBP-EGFP tag was inserted 'between the signal peptide and the mature polypeptide' of full-length membrane-anchored ITGA5. The signal peptide spans residues 1–41 (last residue G41) and the mature N-terminus begins at F42; therefore insert_after_residue = 41, with residue_before = G and residue_after = F, both read directly from the numbered sequence. The tag is on the extracellular face (the mature N-terminus is extracellular, >950 residues from the TM boundary at 1000). L2 confirms functional surface display: FN binding and β1 heterodimerization are unaffected. Full-length, membrane-anchored human ITGA5 expressed in mammalian cells with an SBP-EGFP tag inserted between the signal peptide (residues 1–41) and the mature ectodomain (residue 42 onward), generating the RUSH-α5 construct used for live-cell trafficking studies. L2 confirms that the tagged construct binds fibronectin and heterodimerizes with β1 normally.

sources.claim: Given that the N-terminus of the α5 polypeptide is localized between the two integrin subunits, away from the FN ligand binding site, we inserted the IL-2 signal peptide, the streptavidin-binding peptide (SBP) and enhanced green fluorescent protein (EGFP) in this region to generate an SBP-EGFP-integrin α5 construct (henceforth referred to as RUSH-α5) ( Fig. 1 A , Fig.

literature_notes: L3 and L4 (PMC12860946) report GFP- and FLAG-tagged zebrafish Itgα5 mutants but name no residue, junction, or terminus for the tag insertion; the position cannot be pinned and no site can be derived from these clips alone. L5, L6, and L7 (PMC8227800) report α5-RFP in zebrafish with L7 explicitly stating 'All fluorophores were tagged at the Integrin C-terminus'; the C-terminus of ITGA5 (residue 1049) falls in the intracellular domain (residues 1021–1049) and therefore does not qualify as an extracellular surface tag site — it is recorded in other_positions instead.

literature_other_positions.note: RFP fused to the C-terminus of full-length integrin α5 (zebrafish); L7 states all fluorophores were tagged at the integrin C-terminus, but residue 1049 lies within the intracellular tail (topology landmarks: intracellular 1021–1049), making this an intracellular label, not an extracellular surface tag.
